stem: What happens next in this passage after “The model predicted less traffic in one area but more in another.”?
options: But a city worker explained that people often create paths where they need to go.
The engineer explained that a digital model is useful, but it is not the real city.
The engineer explained that 3D printing allowed designs to be changed quickly as the child grew.
Meteorologists explained that the chart was only one possible model from many days before the storm.

本文可直接核對「The model predicted less traffic in one area but more in another. The engineer explained that a digital model is useful, but…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The engineer explained that 3D printing allowed designs to be changed quickly as the child grew.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The model predicted less traffic in one area but more in another. The engineer explained that a digital model is useful, but it is…」，答案為「The engineer explained that a digital model is useful, but it is not the real city.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The engineer explained that a digital model is useful, but it is not the real city.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
